_streak: A run of good serves in a row, shared by the whole kitchen: the dish at min_quality or better (0.7 is Great) and brought within max_wait_seconds of ordering. From the second serve in a run, that customer tips tip_percent_per_step more for each serve before it, up to max_tip_percent. A poor or slow serve ends the run; it starts again each day. A food order waits under a ring over the customer (WaitRing) that empties at max_wait_seconds: green within fast_service_seconds, amber after, red in the last just_in_time_seconds. Serving in those last seconds is a save: just_in_time pops and they tip just_in_time_tip_percent more. Serving pops the dish's quality over the customer, with the run (from x2) or why it ended; paying pops the money, the tip and the streak's share of it.
